subject: general
question:
Choose the most appropriate one-word substitution for the sentence below. 

Despite preaching honesty and integrity, the politician was later caught in a major corruption scandal, revealing his ______
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hypocrisy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hypocrisy"** refers to the practice of claiming to have moral standards or beliefs to which one's own behavior does not conform. (पाखंड)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite advocating for environmental conservation, his hypocrisy was exposed when he was found dumping waste illegally.
 
 
 
• **"Integrity"** means the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles. (ईमानदारी)
 
 
• **Example:** Her integrity was unquestionable as she always adhered to ethical practices at work.
 
 
 
• Hence, in the given context, the politician was caught in a corruption scandal, revealing his hypocrisy rather than integrity.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hypocrisy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Integrity **(ईमानदारी): The quality of being honest and morally upright.
 
 
• **Example:** A leader’s integrity is essential to gain the trust of the people.
 
 

 
• **Modesty **(विनम्रता): The quality of being humble or unassuming.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his success, he carried himself with modesty and grace.
 
 

 
• **Generosity **(उदारता): The quality of being kind and willing to give.
 
 
• **Example:** Her generosity towards the needy was admired by everyone in the community.
